title: Plant growth prediction with reliability
disclosure: Sanitized V1.4.4 DeepSeek online development trace (v141_s04). Numerical values are preserved from the frozen result; local paths and call identifiers are removed. V1.4.5 status-contract fixes have not been revalidated online.
query: 预测植株 2023-111 从 2023-05-14 起七天后的株高，并评价可靠性。

outcome.summary: 当前株高 29.50 cm、LAI 1.40；模型估计 7 天后株高 42.75 cm。该值是实验性预测，不是未来实测值，也没有校准预测区间。

tool_calls.name: assess_prediction_reliability
tool_calls.arguments_summary: matching plant scope and available inputs

claims.text: The locked model estimates height at t+7 as 42.75 cm.

evidence.summary: Exact-date current height and LAI for plant 2023-111.
Known domain and matching scope; not statistically calibrated.

limitations: Prediction depends strongly on current height and LAI.
Strong cross-season sensor domain shift exists.
Public research data, not a live greenhouse.
